measured_tip_precedes_merge_tip.commentary: crates/jammi-ai/src/inference/audio_preprocess.rs changed in two places on the timed path: resample_linear's output-length arithmetic was extracted into a shared resampled_len() helper (identical arithmetic; the branch's own byte-identity oracles at pool sizes 1/5/7/24 hold), and a sequential O(n) zero-sample refusal pass was added before the parallel per-clip stage; the par_chunks_mut stage, decode_*_results, and preprocess_image_batch* are untouched. Every other file in this deviation's own files_changed_since_measured_tip list is off the front-end path (BackendOutput row accessors, session query paths, HttpBackend, tests, CHANGELOG).

recorded_deviations: the pod's own base-tree checkout emitted 'error: invalid object 100644 4dbdd2167e924cbd7b847b5588fe08748fb8e889 for .github/workflows/ci.yml' twice during the base-tree sync phase (job log 'base tree' phase) -- BASE_SYNC_RC=0 (the checkout still completed and the base binary's own provenance was cross-checked against c1b0b0ba by frontend_ab.sh's own _check_provenance before any leg ran), and .github/workflows/ci.yml is off this unit's own hot path (never read by finetune-run) -- recorded as an observed anomaly, never silently dropped.

the pod's own CPU was shared-host at launch: ~40 loadavg observed against a cgroup CPU quota of 26 (identity phase: '2635000 100000' -> 26.35 CPUs; the tip binary's own rayon_pool_threads=26 matches this quota, not the host's full logical CPU count) -- the HTSAT bar's own P=26 already reflects this quota mechanically (read from every tip leg's own report), so this is context for why P=26 rather than a full 64-core count, not a caveat on any re-derived number.

the driver's own FRONTEND_AB_SERIAL_TAIL_RATIO=0.0033 is a REHEARSAL-derived default, not this run's own measurement; this run's own 'cargo run -p jammi-bench --example frontend_serial_tail' measurement (t_s=0.00474603615 s for HTSAT, task=audio_embedding, dims=[24, 4, 1001, 64], reps=20, device=cuda:0) is committed verbatim in fixtures/frontend_ab_final/serial_tail.txt and read off it via --serial-tail, re-deriving a SECOND htsat_bar block (htsat_bar_measured_r) under the SAME pinned rule -- both variants are carried in the committed artifact and their own verdicts are asserted equal (the 'driver default vs measured; verdict invariant' deviation), never only the driver-default one.

CLIP-vision's own serial-tail measurement (t_s=0.0011608887 s, dims=[24, 3, 224, 224]) was also captured this run but is not used by any bar (CLIP-vision is report-only under this contract) -- recorded here for completeness, not asserted against anything.
